name: agy-supervised-development
description: Astra defines/reviews/freezes tests; Herdr-managed AGY implements/tests; deterministic evidence validation completes.

interface.shortDescription: Astra plans/reviews; AGY builds/tests; evidence completes.
interface.longDescription: Use Astra for a compact Contract, code-only review and a frozen structured Test Plan; use Herdr-managed AGY for implementation, bounded diagnostics/rework and formal test execution; finish only through deterministic evidence validation.
capabilities: Freeze compact Development Contracts with observable acceptance scenarios
Capture recoverable Git baselines and deliverable identity
Freeze structured test checks, applicability and metrics
Execute AGY work only through Herdr
Validate TEST entry and COMPLETE from current repository evidence
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development 4.1: Astra freezes WHAT/BOUNDARY/DONE plus observable scenarios and optional bounded diagnostics; Herdr-managed AGY implements; Astra reviews the full deliverable without running tests; Astra freezes the machine Test Plan; AGY executes formal tests; only the deterministic run-state validator may mark COMPLETE.
